title: Ukrainian — ALA-LC (Library of Congress)
authority: Library of Congress / American Library Association, Ukrainian romanization table (2011)
description: Library of Congress romanization of Ukrainian used in library catalogues, with ligature ties: Г→H, Ґ→G, Є→I͡E, Ж→Z͡H, И→Y, Ї→Ï, Й→Ĭ, Ц→T͡S, Ю→I͡U, Я→I͡A, Ь→ʹ.
notes: Ties (U+0361) distinguish ж (z͡h) from зг (zh) and ц (t͡s) from тс (ts). Both tied letters are capitalized for a capital Cyrillic letter (I͡Aroslav), as in LC catalogue practice; done with post rules.
The apostrophe has no row in the LoC table. This scheme renders it ʺ (U+02BA), following LC cataloguing practice (e.g. obʺi͡ednanni͡a); other users drop it or keep ’. Uncertain.
'Modified LC' used in English texts drops ties, diacritics and ʹ, writes initial Ye-/Y-/Yu-/Ya- and -yi/-ii → -y (Yaroslav Rudnytsky); not encoded here.
